title: ASME A18.1 platform lifts (through update notices)
edition: ASME A18.1-2017/2020 as quoted in Intertek's update notices
notes: A18.1 itself was not read; values come from published summaries of its changes. A lift without a runway enclosure is limited to 1500 mm of travel (not checked yet).

limits.description: Vertical platform lift with a full or partial runway enclosure: travel at most 4250 mm (168 in); rated load 250–475 kg
